detail.longDescription: 🐈 NEW: Behavioral researchers at the University of # SãoPaulo placed favorite treats inside sealed plastic containers for 38 pet # cats . When a person sat nearby, the cats produced 86 meows compared to just 20 when left alone, while looking back and forth between the human and the food. This indicates that cats treat vocalizations and eye contact as targeted requests for assistance rather than simple outbursts of frustration. 👉 https://www. zmescience.com/science/domesti c-science/your-cat-has-a-surprisingly-sophisticated-way-of-asking-for-help-and-it-uses-it-a-lot/ # animals # nature # behavior # science # biology # pets # research # psychology # communication # zoology # evolution # felines
